about: GameCube save-file layout of Pokemon XD, generated by savelayout.py from include/game/pxdvs/app/memcard/saveLayout.h (compiler debug info, not hand-written offsets). Offsets/sizes are GameCube (big-endian). Section ids are savedataGetStatus kinds.

file.name: PokemonXD
file.writer: fn_801CC508 builds the header, _memcardJobMain state 18 writes it (0x6000, or 0x4000 when f40)

slot.choose: load: higher saveCounter of the two slots whose magic is 1,1,1 (_memcardExamineHeader); save: the other slot ((f20 + 1) % 2), saveCounter + 1
slot.write: _memcardJobMain state 38: CARDWrite 0x28000 at the slot (kind 8: 0x26000, then state 41 the last 0x2000 after a GBA check)

pack.sections_base: pack + 0xA0 + offset (offsets from the SavePackHeader table; gamedata is at 0)
pack.order: random: the card writer (_memcardDuplicateSaveData_multi) places the 15 non-gamedata sections in an HSD_Rand-shuffled order starting at pack + 0x140, so readers MUST use the offset table
pack.filler: before placing, the writer adds a fresh key stream (HSD_Rand key) to the WHOLE old pack buffer (pack words 0..0x13FE7): every byte no section covers (reserve sections, gaps, header 0x84..0x9F) is noise

checksums.name: pack block sums
checksums.range: pack u16 words [i*0x4FFA, (i+1)*0x4FFA) for i = 0..3 = pack bytes 0x0..0x27FCF (incl. the key seed; the 8 sum words are 0 while summing)
checksums.algorithm: u32 sum of big-endian u16 words, computed BEFORE scrambling (plain data)

checksums.name: slot header sum
checksums.code: _memcardSaveSetup writes it, _memcardCheckSum checks it on load (only when pack+0x18 == 0x88)

checksums.name: low-memory sum
checksums.range: 0x600 u32 words at GameCube address 0x80001800..0x80002FFF (not save data)
checksums.algorithm: u32 sum; written at every save, not checked by the memcard code

scramble.range: pack bytes 0x8..0x27FCF (u16 words 4..0x13FE7); key seed pack[0..7] and slot bytes 0..7 + the 0x28-byte tail stay in the clear
scramble.algorithm: key = 4 u16 from pack words 0..3; for each group of 4 words: word[k] += key[k] (u16, decrypt: -=), then key step: v[j] = key[j] + {0x43, 0x29, 0x17, 0x13}[j]; key[n] = nibble transpose of v (nibble m of key[n] = nibble n of v[m])
scramble.order: save: fill sections -> sums over plain pack -> scramble -> random tail; load: unscramble -> check sums -> check slot header sum
scramble.code: _memcard_Encryption, _memcard_Decryption, _memcardKeyStep (memcard.cpp); _memcardDecryptHeader = same over pack words 4..0xFB only (reads the gamedata memcardID of the other slot)

byte_order: The whole image is GameCube memory order = big-endian; scramble and sums work on big-endian u16 words.
SavePackHeader 32-bit values are stored as (lo u16, hi u16) pairs, i.e. NOT a big-endian u32.

Sections are copied RAW from the in-memory savedata (struct assignment / memcpy): every field keeps its GameCube big-endian in-memory representation; bitfields are CodeWarrior top-bit-first (types[].bit_shift).
Member-wise copies (gamedata, pcbox, mailbox, sodateya, memo, tool, relive) skip padding: sections[].not_copied.

Map state (anywaysave data) = byte streams: GSBinWriteStream writes u16/u32/float big-endian byte by byte (unaligned); only the SaveAnywayHeader, the FLOR headers and the colsys record are raw u32/u16 structs.

in_memory.note: savedata + 0x0..0x9F has no known accessor (savedataGetStatus(0) = the base)

sections.name: flags
sections.copy: word copy 0x20+0x80+0x600+0x14 (MemcardSave23); reader splits by the 0x78.. byte counts

subsections.name: flagLevel0
subsections.note: count = savedataGetStatus(7) = 8 words; pack byte count at 0x78

map_state.container: SaveAnywaySave: SaveAnywayHeader (0x20) + Tiga stream (scriptStateSize) + FLOR block (pushStateSize)
map_state.tiga_stream: Tiga::makeStateData (tiga.cpp ~1637): u32 0, stateId, ftblId, chankSize, threadCount, 4 floats timers, 16 u8 userFlags, u32 nextHandle, bool saveFlag, u32 unk930, u32 gvarCount + tigaVariant records, u32 arrayCount + per array (bool flag, [u32 size + variants]), u32 8 + 8 TigaThread records. TigaThread::makeStateData: pc / bp / sp / cp as INDICES (byte offset >> 2 or >> 3), not addresses. tigaVariant::makeStateData (tvariant.cpp ~849): u16 type, then by type: 0x35 code index, 1 int, 2 float, 7 object id, 4 vec (3 floats), 5 0x30 raw bytes (12 BE floats), 0x23 group+object ids, 3 u16 length + string bytes.

modules_mode3.record: stream: u16 0x3C7, u8 0, 3 bool, u16 index, 11 floats

stream: u16 0x103, u8 4, u8 count; per person u8 used; if used: u16 record length, SavePeopleFlags (5 raw bytes), u32 flags, groupID, peopleID, objectID, float speed, u8 motion, float speed, vec position, vec destination, u8 pointCount [u8 pointIndex + vecs], target (type 1: 2 u32 ids, type 2: vec), model pos vec + savedPosition vec + rotY + targetAngle (or 20 zero bytes)
none (mode 3 only calls Hero::setRestertPos into section hero)

heap_addresses.summary: No field of the save image holds a real pointer or heap address: every typed section is plain data (the only pointer-typed save structure, FlagLevel::bits, lives in the flag_level table, not in the save), and the map state stores script/code positions as indices and objects as ids.

looks_like_addresses.where: anywaysave map state, people records (port diff: section 22 +0x235C..0x27DC)
looks_like_addresses.why: peopleSave.cpp _makeAnywaySaveData writes a stack local SavedFlags with only the named bits set; the rest is leftover stack (e.g. a stale heap pointer 0x810019D0 -> bytes c1 00 19 d0 81). Restore reads only the named bits. PC (2fe2efed) clears the local: deterministic 0.

looks_like_addresses.where: section padding (sections[].not_copied) and every byte outside the sections
looks_like_addresses.why: not written by the card writer: stale pack buffer bytes plus key stream on GameCube, 0 on PC.

fields.name: memcardID
fields.comment: 0x00 CARDGetSerialNo of the card it was saved to (_memcardSetSaveId)

fields.name: parChecksum
fields.comment: 0x10 status 12: sum of the 0x600 u32 at 0x80001800 (written at every save)

fields.name: sysHeadChecksum
fields.comment: 0x30 status 13: byte sum of the 8 slot header bytes (_memcardCheckSum)

fields.name: pad4
fields.comment: 0x04 not copied to the card (MemcardSave1 padding)

fields.name: playdata44
fields.comment: 0x44 copied word by word (MemcardSave1::w); no accessor names them

fields.name: unkTail
fields.comment: no accessor known for the tail

fields.name: nameTerm
fields.comment: 0x12 not copied to the card (padding in the card writer)

fields.name: escapeOrSnatchTime
fields.comment: 0x20 escape time while status < 3, snatch time after

fields.name: unk6B0
fields.comment: 0x6B0 copied by the card writer (MemcardBlock14 tail), never named

fields.name: totalSize
fields.comment: 0x04 m_valid: 0x20 + scriptStateSize + pushStateSize (0 = no map state)

fields.name: scriptStateSize
fields.comment: 0x08 bytes of the Tiga stream at 0x20

fields.name: pushStateSize
fields.comment: 0x0C bytes of the "FLOR" module block after it

fields.name: gameTitle
fields.comment: 0x0000 comment line 1 ("POKeMON XD", Shift-JIS in Japan)

fields.name: checksum
fields.comment: 0x3A40 sum of the 0xE90 s32 words at 0x0000..0x3A3F (fn_801CC508)

fields.name: saveCounter
fields.comment: 0x00004 grows by 1 every save; the higher one of the 2 slots is loaded

fields.name: pack
fields.comment: 0x00008 SavePackHeader + sections; scrambled from pack+8 on (_memcard_Encryption)

fields.name: randomTail
fields.comment: 0x27FD8 HSD_Rand bytes, written after the scramble; not checked

fields.name: key
fields.comment: 0x00 scramble key seed (HSD_Rand), stored in the clear

fields.name: sum0
fields.comment: 0x14 block 0: words 0x00000..0x0503D (the 8 sum words count as 0)

fields.name: sizeFlags
fields.comment: 0x28 0x6B4 (any other value: the flag block is copied in one piece)

fields.name: offGamedata
fields.comment: 0x38 section offsets, relative to pack + 0xA0 (gamedata: always 0)
